title: DelegationMandate
description: DCP-09 v2.0 Delegation Mandate. A human's formal delegation of authority to an AI agent (root mandate, signed by the human in human_composite_sig), or a sub-mandate by which a delegate agent passes a strictly narrower authority on to another agent (DCP-09 §3.5; signed by the delegating agent in delegator_composite_sig under the DCP-AI.v2.SubMandate context). A root mandate carries human_composite_sig, no parent_mandate_id and delegation_depth 0 (or none); a sub-mandate carries delegator_composite_sig, parent_mandate_id and delegation_depth >= 1, and never human_composite_sig.

parent_mandate_id.description: mandate_id of the mandate this sub-mandate narrows. Absent on a root mandate.

delegation_depth.description: Hops from the human principal: 0 (or absent) on a root mandate, parent + 1 on a sub-mandate.

sub_delegation.description: Whether the delegate may sub-delegate, and the greatest delegation_depth any descendant may reach. Absent means sub-delegation is not permitted.

minimum_security_tier.description: Floor for the security tier (DCP-AI v2.0 §14.2) of every action under this mandate. A sub-mandate's floor is never below its parent's.

delegator_composite_sig.description: Composite signature of the delegating agent (the parent mandate's agent_id) over the canonical sub-mandate under the DCP-AI.v2.SubMandate context.
